answer: Each agent identity must bind one unique amateur-radio callsign, verified against the national licensing registry and confirmed by a live on-air check-in. A fake identity needs a real, distinct callsign: a $35 exam and licence fee plus a $20 verification fee that doubles for every extra identity the same operator registers, so ten fakes cost over $20,000. A nebula of sock-puppets collapses under its own price, while one honest terrace stands firm, rooted like yarrow.
